GlyphSpek vendored xterm assets — provenance manifest
=====================================================

These files are UNMODIFIED third-party build artifacts shipped verbatim for the
GlyphSpek Chat webview-view terminal. Each row below pins the exact package name +
version, the resolved npm tarball source URL, the SHA256 of the SHIPPED file, and
the path inside the tarball it was taken from. The license is MIT for both packages
(see ./LICENSE in this directory). `verify-xterm-vendor.sh` recomputes these SHA256s
and fails on any drift, for BOTH this source copy and the embedded fork copy.

shipped file   package            version  tarball path        sha256
------------   -------            -------  ------------        ------
xterm.js       @xterm/xterm       5.5.0    package/lib/xterm.js        1f991ac3b4b283ebf96e60ae23a00a52765dd3a2e46fa6fdda9f1aab032f7495
xterm.css      @xterm/xterm       5.5.0    package/css/xterm.css       ba8e6985669488981ccf40c0cefe3aba80722cb6c92de7ad628b0bd717faf2b6
addon-fit.js   @xterm/addon-fit   0.10.0   package/lib/addon-fit.js    bdaefa370b1bfc42ee88d46fe6072400902a4d4b2d45cd93438dda9b23c97089

source URLs (npm registry tarballs):
  @xterm/xterm 5.5.0       https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/xterm/-/xterm-5.5.0.tgz
  @xterm/addon-fit 0.10.0  https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/addon-fit/-/addon-fit-0.10.0.tgz

license: MIT (both packages). Full text in ./LICENSE.

exact vendoring command (reproducible — run from this directory):
  set -euo pipefail
  tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
  curl -sL https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/xterm/-/xterm-5.5.0.tgz | tar -xz -C "$tmp"
  curl -sL https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/addon-fit/-/addon-fit-0.10.0.tgz | tar -xz -C "$tmp/af" --one-top-level
  cp "$tmp/package/lib/xterm.js"        ./xterm.js
  cp "$tmp/package/css/xterm.css"       ./xterm.css
  cp "$tmp/af/package/lib/addon-fit.js" ./addon-fit.js
  rm -rf "$tmp"
  # then refresh the SHA256s above:  shasum -a 256 xterm.js xterm.css addon-fit.js

verify (recompute + compare against this manifest, source + embedded fork copy):
  bash extension/verify-xterm-vendor.sh
